case_classification.short_description: DCF (two methods) with given estimates, 3-SM based on percentages + plug without extensive forecasting

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This task is highly complex as it requires building a 120-month (10-year) integrated 3-statement model with day-weighted compounding rates based on the exact number of days in each month/year. Additionally, it features complex, non-standard rules such as periodic tax-deductible Goodwill impairment (halving every 3rd year), intricate Right-of-Use (RoU) asset splits and depreciation treatments, and two distinct DCF valuation runs (one with a circular iterative WACC and one with a target capital structure WACC). Fully constructing, balancing, and audit-checking this model to accurately answer the 100 precise monthly output questions will take an expert financial modeler about 4 hours.
